scenario: Floa global shortcut startup registration and fallback collision handling

reference.source: Glaso public shortcut documentation and installed tutorial/localized settings evidence
expectedBehavior: Allow shortcuts to be disabled together
Keep saved shortcut assignments available for Floa-focused use
Do not let a fallback summon key override an explicitly assigned shortcut
Avoid leaving a partially registered global shortcut set after an OS collision
reference.fidelity: Behavioral comparison only; no Glaso code, binaries, or assets used.

implementation.startupPath: Register all enabled global shortcuts through one all-or-nothing registry path.
implementation.failureBehavior: If a configured accelerator cannot register, unregister the partial set, turn the global-shortcuts setting off, and preserve the user's assignments.
implementation.fallbackBehavior: Register CommandOrControl+Shift+Space as an optional backup only when it is not assigned to any configured shortcut.

validation.method: Node VM harness evaluated the exact registration functions extracted from main.cjs with a mocked Electron globalShortcut API.

cases.fallbackAssignedToMediaMute: pass; the assigned action retained CommandOrControl+Shift+Space and no duplicate summon registration replaced it
cases.fallbackUnassigned: pass; the optional summon fallback was registered
cases.configuredAcceleratorUnavailable: pass; partial registrations were removed and registration returned failure

validation.nativeMacOSKeyDispatch: not tested; no application window was opened or focused
